steps.actual: The handle "Reorder DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0928073017, position 13 of …" moved to position 12 with ArrowUp and kept it after reload.

steps.action: Archive a type in use: read the usage count, choose the live replacement, confirm; the dialog lists only live types; Other shows a lock
steps.expected: The dialog shows the usage count and offers only live types other than the target; the record moves to the replacement.
steps.actual: Archiving the unused "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Archived probe type 0928073017" read "Archive DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Archived probe type 0928073017 DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Archived probe type 0928073017 is not used by any matters — it can be archived without reassignment. ". M-20 (API fixture) used "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0928073017"; its row read "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0928073017 1 matter". steps.action: Default type: Contracts and Matters each have one type named Default with no label; its row shows Archive, and the dialog refuses and says it is the Default type
steps.expected: The Archive dialog refuses the Default type with a reason; the type stays live.
steps.actual: Contract types: row "Default 2 contracts" (no Default label); the Archive dialog read "Archive Default Default is used by 2 contracts. Matter types: row "Default 1 matter" (no Default label); the Archive dialog read "Archive Default Default is used by 1 matter. Reassign 1 matter to No reassignment E"; after choosing a replacement and Archive it showed "Default is the Default type and cannot be archived or deleted: module-only Requests need its Form."; the Default row stayed live after reload.

steps.action: Create dialogs preselect the Default type
steps.expected: The Create matter dialog preselects Default as its Matter type.
steps.actual: Matters > Create matter opened with Matter type "Default" preselected.

steps.action: Show archived and Restore: restoring makes the type available again and does not move reassigned records back
steps.expected: Show archived lists the archived type with Restore; after Restore it is live and the reassigned Matter keeps the replacement.
steps.actual: Show archived listed "DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0928073017" with "Restore DOC-032 compat compat-c V-C38 Supplier assessment renamed 0928073017". steps.expected: The archive dialog cannot offer these choices, so the API is asked directly and refuses both with a 400 and a reason.

steps.action: Set reminder lead times, steps 1-2: profile menu > Settings > Organization > Notifications shows Reminder lead times; Personal > Notifications changes only your preferences

steps.action: Steps 3-5: Add lead time with Save; Cancel discards; a duplicate and 731 are refused; reorder with the arrow keys; Remove; reload and confirm; at most 20 entries
steps.expected: The new lead time is added; duplicates and 731 are refused; the reorder persists after reload; a 21st entry is refused; Remove removes an entry.
